description: This image contains no scientific figure. It is a publisher-generated "Check for updates" badge (the Crossref/Elsevier update-check logo), not an experimental panel. Visually it consists of a circular ring broken into two arc segments — a yellow left/lower arc and a light-blue upper/right arc — encircling a solid red ribbon (bookmark) shape whose bottom edge is cut into an inverted V notch. Beneath the icon, two lines of dark grey sans-serif text are printed and are fully legible: "Check for" on the first line and "updates" on the second, stacked left-aligned. The background is white with a faint light-grey gradient toward the outer margins characteristic of a UI badge render. There are no axes, no units, no scale bars, no legends, no data points, no sample labels, no micrographs and no composition or processing information of any kind. The badge carries no bearing on the paper's subject (machine-learning prediction of Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si steel solid-solution strengthening); it conveys only the meta-information that the document's version of record has been updated since publication. Because no panel structure and no quantitative content exist, no decomposition into subfigures is possible and no values can be extracted.
